verdict.rationale: OpenAI publishes its own API reference, for example a Responses create-method page, and a maintained Cookbook of practical code examples. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-browser, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console or playground in the reference, runnable in-page examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Have the model call your own custom code or use built-in tools like web search or file search to use your own data as input for the model's response.
Practical code examples and patterns for APIs, agents, evals, multimodal applications, and integrations
